# Season Shelf 1.2.0

- Rebuilt the interface with React and TypeScript, organized into reusable feature components. Background updates preserve focused controls, selections and unsaved settings.
- Simplified page headings and navigation, standardized button spacing, and improved keyboard/dialog behaviour. Downloads still opens on Ongoing; Finished retains completed history separately from files on disk.
- New download folders no longer need `.season-shelf-root.json`. Existing destination markers are migrated into app storage and removed after a successful checkpoint. Destination identity checks remain in place.
- Network requests now refill before staging writes, allowing the next request to overlap disk work. This is a pipeline improvement, not a guaranteed speed increase; the reported Telegram slowdown has not been reproduced in a live comparison.
- Added runtime validation for desktop messages, protection against stale discovery results, and regression coverage for queue state and lifetime counters.

Removing history preserves completed media and lifetime network/download totals. Clearing unfinished queue entries removes their temporary data; pausing retains resumable progress.

Windows users can update their existing installation. macOS users should quit the app and replace it in Applications. Downloaded media is preserved. Builds remain unsigned.
